- Initial release of multi-platform-content-calendar.
- Automatically generates content schedules across Douyin, Xiaohongshu, Bilibili, and WeChat Official Accounts.
- Links planned content with holidays and trending events for smarter scheduling.
- Tracks performance metrics (likes, comments, shares, followers) for each post.
- Provides weekly/monthly content planning and review reports.
- Recommends best posting times and content types based on platform data and past performance.
